title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President

description.narrative: BUIDCo and ULB improve infrastructure, operations and sustainability in water supply in Bhagalpur.

By 2021, 12,500 customers billed monthly (none in 2010). Progress/Status: A single contract under the loan terminated. Balance work was bid out split into 4 packages. All 4 contracts have been signed and work has started. The target is likely to be achieved. Data Source: Water supply operators' or third party validators' service quality compliance reports, containing sex-disaggregated, poverty level categorized, and vulnerability-identified data. Actual value:

By 2021, NRW reduced from 30%-40% in 2010 to less than 20%. Progress/Status: A single contract under the loan was terminated. Balance work was bid out split into 4 packages. One pacakge was forclosed due to non requirement of the work. Work is ongoing in the remaining three contracts and are likely to be completed by September 2023. Data Source: Water supply operators' or third party validators' service quality compliance reports. Actual value:
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: 1. Water supply infrastructure rehabilitated and newly constructed in Bhagalpur. Indicator: By 2021, 12,500 piped connection newly installed at households (5.4% of which are women-headed households) through a DBO contract. Achievement: 1709 Progress/Status: Single contract under the loan has been terminated. Balance work was bid out split in 4 packages. All the 4 contracts have been signed and work has started. 27,587 household piped connection has been provided. The target is over-achieved. Data Source: UDHD's quarterly progress reports, containing sex-disaggregated, poverty level categorized, and vulnerability-identified data.

Output: 1. Water supply infrastructure rehabilitated and newly constructed in Bhagalpur. Indicator: By 2021, 224 km of pipes laid through a DBO contract. Achievement: 3 Progress/Status: Single contract under the loan terminated.Balance work was bid out split in 4 packages. All the 4 contracts have been signed and work has started. 346.72 km pipeline has been laid. The target has been over-acheived. Data Source: UDHD's quarterly progress reports.

Output: 2. Staffing and skills for water supply operations improved in Bhagalpur. Indicator: By 2021, 16 ULB's O&M staff's qualifications upgraded. Progress/Status: Ongoing. The O&M has been handed over to BMC. The target is likely to be achieved. Data Source: Training completion certificates. Actual value:

Output: 4. Subproject implemented on time within the budget in a transparent manner. Indicator: Contract award and disbursement achieved not less than 80% of the annual targets and result disclosed in each year from 2012-2021. Progress/Status: Single contract under the loan was terminated in July 2019.Balance work was bid out split in 4 packages. All the 4 contracts have been signed and work has started. The target is likely to be achieved. Data Source: LFIS and TPRM's reports on financial progress. Actual value:

Output: 1. Water supply infrastructure rehabilitated and newly constructed in Bhagalpur. Indicator: By 2021, original WTP capacity brought back from 12mld to 17 mld through a DBO contract. Progress/Status: Single contract under the loan been terminated. Balance work was bid out split in 4 packages. All the 4 contracts have been signed and work has started. Till Termination, WTP capacity was enhanced to pump 13-14 mld. The target is likely to be achieved. Data Source: UDHD's quarterly progress reports. Actual value:

Output: 2. Staffing and skills for water supply operations improved in Bhagalpur. Indicator: By 2021, O&M staff increased from 50 in 2010 to 190 (at least 30% of whom are women) through a DBO contract. Progress/Status: Currently, 206 O&M staff are operating the system. The O&M has been handed over to BMC. The target is achieved. Data Source: Water supply operators' or third party validators' service quality compliance reports, containing sex-disaggregated, poverty level categorized, and vulnerability-identified data. Actual value:

Output: 2. Staffing and skills for water supply operations improved in Bhagalpur. Indicator: By 2021, 100% of operational staff follows the O&M manuals during operation period. Progress/Status: Operational staff abide by O&M manuals. Data Source: Water supply operators' or third party validators' service quality compliance reports. Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Target year: 2021 Target value: Y

Output: 3. Systems for water supply service delivery management improved in Bhagalpur. Indicator: By 2021, user charges for water supply, incorporating special concessionary arrangements for vulnerable and/or women-headed households, implemented. Progress/Status: Tariff is fixed by Government of Bihar and accordingly concerned ULB has to implement Data Source: User charges tables from ULB of Bhagalpur. Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Target year: 2021 Target value: Y

Output: 3. Systems for water supply service delivery management improved in Bhagalpur. Indicator: From 2021, water operations financial statement issued every year. (none in 2010). Progress/Status: Water operations financial statements are being issue. Data Source: Balance sheet for water supply operations from ULB of Bhagalpur. Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Target year: 2021 Target value: Y

Output: 4. Subproject implemented on time within the budget in a transparent manner. Indicator: Project information disclosed to public and updated quarterly. Progress/Status: Project information are being disclosed to public and being updated quarterly. Data Source: Project web sites. Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Target year: 2021 Target value: Y
